sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Vijay Bahadur Shivhare
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the material brought on record.

2. The second bail application has been filed by the applicant-accused in Case Crime No.607 of 2021,
under Sections - 498A, 304B I.P.C. and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station- Rath,
District- Hamirpur with the prayer to enlarge the applicant-accused on bail.
The first bail application of the applicant has been dismissed for want of prosecution by this Court vide order dated 31.01.2024 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.37858 of 2022.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.37858 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 3. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has not committed any offence.

Applicant is husband of deceased and their marriage has taken place on Mukesh vs State Of U.P. on 10 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/37692748/
1 15.07.2021.
The allegations of dowry demand and harassment of deceased are wholly false.
Only general allegations have been levelled against all the accused persons including the applicant.

It was submitted that only four days prior to the incident, deceased was brought from her parental home and, thereafter, on the occasion of bhaiyadooj, no one has visited from her parental home, due to which, she was under depression and committed suicide.
In this connection, statement of one Kalawati was referred.
In postmortem report, except ligature mark, no other injury has been shown on body of deceased and cause of death has been shown asphyxia as a result of ante-mortem hanging.

4. It is further submitted that applicant-accused is in jail since 08.11.2021 and only part statement of one witness has been recorded so far but after that he is not appearing for his further statement.
The trial Court has even issued non-bailable warrants against P.W. 1 but he is not been appearing for further statement.
It was submitted that trial of the case would take sufficient long time.

Lastly, it was submitted that applicant is languishing in jail since 08.11.2021, having no criminal history, and that in case the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate in trial.
5.

Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant is husband of deceased and that deceased has suffered death other than under normal circumstances within a short period of one year of her marriage.

6. Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of detention and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, a case for bail is made out.
7. The bail application is allowed.

8. Let the applicant - Mukesh involved in aforesaid case be released on bail on furnishing each a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:
i.
The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
ii. The applicant shall not pressurize/ intimidate any of the prosecution witness.
iii. The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.

v. The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the Mukesh vs State Of U.P. on 10 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/37692748/
2 evidence.
9.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the Court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel bail of applicant in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 10.5.2024 SP/-
